description:
Take on the role of a manager in the most addictive simulation game - open the doors to your supermarket and build it from scratch, transforming a small shop into the ultimate supermarket! Become a great manager and make your store outstanding.

Manage your own supermarket!
Expand your store, make it bigger and provide the best possible service. Create promotions and set competitive prices so that the goods sell quickly. Handle cash and card payments. Have fun and don't go broke. Achieve real success.

Expand your product range
Unlock new products, activities and services that will satisfy even the most demanding customers.

Customise your supermarket
Prepare your store appropriately for your goods - choose from racks, cabinets, refrigerators or freezers.

Shopkeeper Simulator is not just a game - it is a challenge that will test your management and strategy skills. Try it today and show how a real supermarket is run!
name: Shopkeeper Simulator
